subject: Attachment preview does not update after replacement
report: Replacing a PDF attachment keeps the previous thumbnail until the ticket is reopened.

open-ticket.action: Open a ticket with an existing PDF attachment.
open-ticket.expected: The attachment thumbnail matches the currently stored PDF.

replace-file.action: Replace the attachment with a different PDF while keeping the ticket open.
replace-file.expected: The preview updates to show the replacement file.

reopen-ticket.expected: The same replacement preview remains visible.
